See what is taking up space on your Mac before deleting anything.

Smart Cleaner AI: Disk Cleaner brings storage analysis, cache review, duplicate detection, large-file discovery, app management, startup-item review, browser cleanup, and cloud-folder inspection into one organized workspace.

Scanning, storage analysis, app uninstalling, login-item management, cloud-folder review, and AI-guided suggestions are free. Removing files from supported cleanup categories requires Pro access. You always review and approve items before they are moved to the Trash.

SMART SCAN & CLEANUP REVIEW

Scan supported locations for application caches, user caches, logs, Trash contents, downloads, mail attachments, browser data, developer files, and other common space-consuming items.

Review detected files, sizes, categories, and cleanup suggestions before deciding what should be removed.

DUPLICATE FILES & PHOTOS

Find exact duplicate files and photos inside selected and accessible locations. Compare matching copies, review their sizes and locations, and decide which version you want to keep.

LARGE FILE FINDER

Locate large videos, archives, application data, developer files, downloads, and other items that may be consuming valuable disk space.

APP UNINSTALLER

Review installed applications together with related support files, caches, preferences, and leftovers. See an app’s total storage footprint before uninstalling it.

VISUAL DISK ANALYZER

Explore file and folder sizes through an interactive storage view. Browse accessible categories such as Applications, Photos, Documents, Developer Files, Mail, and Downloads.

AI-GUIDED SUGGESTIONS

Receive smart suggestions highlighting files and categories that may deserve attention. Suggestions help guide your review, while every removal decision remains under your control.

STARTUP ITEMS & LOGIN MANAGER

Review login items, launch agents, daemons, and supported background services. Open the relevant macOS settings and manage startup behavior with your confirmation.

BROWSER PRIVACY & CACHE REVIEW

Inspect supported browser history, cookies, caches, and recent browsing data. Select exactly which items should be cleared.

SCREENSHOT & DOWNLOADS REVIEW

Find accumulated screenshots and files inside your Downloads folder. Review them by size and location before cleaning.

CLOUD STORAGE REVIEW

Inspect accessible local cloud folders, downloaded cloud files, and locally cached cloud data. Manage local copies while maintaining control over what remains available in the cloud.

SECURITY SETTINGS CHECKLIST

Review common macOS security settings, including FileVault, Firewall, Gatekeeper, Remote Login, and software updates. Open the appropriate Apple system settings when changes are needed.

FREE FEATURES

• Smart Scan and storage scanning
• Visual Disk Analyzer
• Cloud storage overview
• App review and uninstaller
• Login-item management
• AI-guided suggestions
• Dashboard and storage information

PRO CLEANUP FEATURES

Cleanup actions require either an auto-renewable Yearly Pro subscription or a one-time Lifetime Pro purchase. Pro cleanup includes removing supported cache and junk files, deleting duplicates, removing large files, clearing browser and privacy data, and cleaning Downloads or Screenshots.

Payment is charged to your Apple ID when your purchase is confirmed. Yearly Pro renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period. You can manage or cancel your subscription in your App Store account settings. Lifetime Pro is a one-time purchase and does not renew.
